C-FIX-012-RENDER-CONFLICT-GUARD.Name: Skip token-conflict checks without complete cursor endpoints
C-FIX-012-RENDER-CONFLICT-GUARD.Summary: Complete the attributed FIX-012 renderer repair at the token-conflict boundary: an absent cursor start or end means no selection conflict, not an endpoint dereference.
C-FIX-012-RENDER-CONFLICT-GUARD.Problem: After selector activity became null-safe, the full command walk reached StateRender.checkConflicted with incomplete cursor state. The method then dereferenced missing start/end endpoints and aborted the cycled-tab render.
C-FIX-012-RENDER-CONFLICT-GUARD.ApprovalBasis: This is a narrow failing-evidence companion to the owner-approved C-FIX-012-TAB-CYCLE-RENDER work. The approved selector companion constrained itself to activity detection, so this separately approved bundle preserves immutable-plan discipline.

Goals.Goal: Return no conflict when either cursor endpoint is absent.
Preserve the existing overlap calculation for a complete cursor.
Keep the full accumulated registry walk warning-free.

Constraints.Constraint: Guard only the token-conflict precondition; do not synthesize cursor state, change token ranges, or suppress renderer exceptions.

NonGoals.NonGoal: No selector-activity change, selection restoration rewrite, tab UX change, Windows/Linux work, release or publication.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: checkConflicted returns false for null or endpoint-less cursor state without throwing.
Complete cursor overlap behavior remains unchanged.
The full registry walk emits no tabs.cycleForward warning.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: Direct incomplete-cursor token-conflict fixtures plus the complete browser command walk.
